examples.pinyin: Lǎopó: Wǒ jiào nǐ mǎi dòujiāng, zěnme mǎi le wútáng de, zhēn nánhē! Lǎogōng: Nǐ yòu méi shuō qīngchu, zěnme néng guài wǒ.
examples.english: Wife: I told you to buy soy milk; how come you bought the sugar-free kind? It tastes awful! Husband: You didn't say clearly, so how can you blame me?

examples.chinese: 大多數的人認為哲學是一門很難的學問，不容易理解。先生的個性很奇怪，又愛亂發脾氣，除了他老婆，沒人能理解他。
examples.pinyin: Dàduōshù de rén rènwéi zhéxué shì yì mén hěn nán de xuéwèn, bù róngyì lǐjiě. Xiānsheng de gèxìng hěn qíguài, yòu ài luàn fā píqì, chúle tā lǎopó, méi rén néng lǐjiě tā.
examples.english: Most people think philosophy is a very difficult subject to understand. The husband's personality is very strange, and he also loves to lose his temper randomly; except for his wife, no one can understand him.

examples.chinese: 管先生這段時間忙著布置新房子，希望給老婆一個又舒適又溫暖的家。
examples.pinyin: Guǎn xiānshēng zhè duàn shíjiān mángzhe bùzhì xīn fángzi, xīwàng gěi lǎopó yí ge yòu shūshì yòu wēnnuǎn de jiā.
examples.english: Mr. Guan has been busy decorating his new house during this time, hoping to give his wife a comfortable and warm home.

examples.chinese: 公司的會議資料都存在雲端，這樣又安全又方便，各部門也能隨時參考。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de huìyì zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, zhèyàng yòu ānquán yòu fāngbiàn, gè bùmén yě néng suíshí cānkǎo.
examples.english: The company's meeting materials are all stored in the cloud; this way it is both safe and convenient, and each department can also refer to them at any time.

examples.chinese: 方小姐既活潑又漂亮，難怪不少男生想追求她。
examples.pinyin: Fāng xiǎojiě jì huópō yòu piàoliang, nánguài bùshǎo nánshēng xiǎng zhuīqiú tā.
examples.english: Miss Fang is both lively and pretty; no wonder many guys want to pursue her.

examples.chinese: 媽媽實在太會做飯了，只用了一個小時就變出一桌既豐富又好吃的大餐。
examples.pinyin: Māma shízài tài huì zuòfàn le, zhǐ yòng le yí ge xiǎoshí jiù biàn chū yì zhuō jì fēngfù yòu hǎochī de dàcān.
examples.english: Mom is really too good at cooking; in just one hour, she conjured up a table full of both abundant and delicious feast.

examples.chinese: 天氣變涼了，奶奶頭痛的毛病又犯了。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì biàn liáng le, nǎinai tóutòng de máobìng yòu fàn le.
examples.english: The weather has turned cool, and Grandma's headache problem has occurred again.

examples.chinese: 學校蓋了一棟活動中心，學生又多了一個交流、休閒的好場所了。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào gài le yī dòng huódòng zhōngxīn, xuéshēng yòu duō le yī gè jiāoliú, xiūxián de hǎo chǎngsuǒ le.
examples.english: The school has built an activity center; the students now have one more good place for interaction and leisure.

examples.chinese: 小偷：我又沒偷東西，為什麼抓我？ 警察：你先別動，只要看了商店攝影機錄下來的內容，就知道事實了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎotōu: Wǒ yòu méi tōu dōngxi, wèishénme zhuā wǒ? Jǐngchá: Nǐ xiān bié dòng, zhǐyào kàn le shāngdiàn shèyǐngjī lù xiàlái de nèiróng, jiù zhīdào shìshí le.
examples.english: Thief: I didn't steal anything, why are you arresting me? Police: Don't move first; as long as you look at what the store's camera recorded, you'll know the fact.

examples.chinese: 這座地下停車場因為缺乏經費，沒辦法改善又暗又溼的情形。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dìxià tíngchēchǎng yīnwèi quēfá jīngfèi, méi bànfǎ gǎishàn yòu àn yòu shī de qíngxíng.
examples.english: Because this underground parking lot lacks funds, there is no way to improve its dark and damp condition.

examples.chinese: 這本小說介紹了許多中國的古人古事，內容既豐富又有趣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎoshuō jièshào le xǔduō Zhōngguó de gǔrén gǔshì, nèiróng jì fēngfù yòu yǒuqù.
examples.english: This novel introduces many stories of ancient Chinese people and events; its content is both rich and interesting.

items.wordHook: A right hand curves out to grab one more item → 又(again).

examples.chinese: 許經理有兩點值得我們學習，第一點是做事仔細，第二點是有耐心。你的白襯衫上面有一個黑點，快脫下來，我幫你洗一洗。
examples.pinyin: Xǔ jīnglǐ yǒu liǎng diǎn zhídé wǒmen xuéxí, dì yī diǎn shì zuòshì zǐxì, dì èr diǎn shì yǒu nàixīn. Nǐ de bái chènshān shàngmiàn yǒu yī gè hēi diǎn, kuài tuō xiàlái, wǒ bāng nǐ xǐ yī xǐ.
examples.english: Manager Xu has two points worth learning from: the first point is that he is careful in his work, and the second point is that he is patient. There is a black spot on your white shirt; quickly take it off, and I'll help you wash it.

examples.chinese: 這個地區被颱風破壞得相當嚴重，不是樹木倒了，就是屋頂被吹走了，情況非常糟糕。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū bèi táifēng pòhuài de xiāngdāng yánzhòng, bùshì shùmù dǎo le, jiùshì wūdǐng bèi chuī zǒu le, qíngkuàng fēicháng zāogāo.
examples.english: This area was damaged quite severely by the typhoon; either trees fell down or roofs were blown away—the situation is very bad.

examples.chinese: 這部電影的字幕翻譯得很糟糕，讓人弄不清楚它的意思。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de zìmù fānyì de hěn zāogāo, ràng rén nòng bù qīngchǔ tā de yìsi.
examples.english: The subtitles of this movie are translated very poorly, making it unclear what it means.

items.wordHook: Combining 糟(bad) and 糕(cake): 糟糕 means bad.

examples.chinese: 我在山上工作，手機的訊號很弱，朋友常抱怨我的電話不是打不通，就是聲音不清楚。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài shānshàng gōngzuò, shǒujī de xìnhào hěn ruò, péngyǒu cháng bàoyuàn wǒ de diànhuà bú shì dǎ bù tōng, jiù shì shēngyīn bù qīngchu.
examples.english: I work in the mountains, and the cell phone signal is very weak. My friends often complain that my phone either can't be reached or the voice is unclear.

examples.chinese: 王老先生年輕時就離開了家鄉，他很想回老家去看看親人。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎoxiānsheng niánqīng shí jiù líkāi le jiāxiāng, tā hěn xiǎng huí lǎojiā qù kànkan qīnrén.
examples.english: Mr. Wang left his hometown when he was young; he really wants to go back to his old home to see his relatives.

examples.chinese: 我去樓下的超市買點菜，待會兒做些家鄉菜給你嘗嘗。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù lóuxià de chāoshì mǎi diǎn cài, dàihuìr zuò xiē jiāxiāng cài gěi nǐ chángchang.
examples.english: I'm going to the supermarket downstairs to buy some groceries; in a moment I'll cook some hometown dishes for you to try.

examples.chinese: 他說的華語帶點兒家鄉口音，聽起來很親切。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de Huáyǔ dài diǎnr jiāxiāng kǒuyīn, tīng qǐlái hěn qīnqiè.
examples.english: The Mandarin he speaks carries a bit of a hometown accent, which sounds very warm and friendly.

examples.chinese: 我的家鄉出產小麥、葡萄，可是不產茶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de jiāxiāng chūchǎn xiǎomài, pútao, kěshì bù chǎn chá.
examples.english: My hometown produces wheat and grapes, but it does not produce tea.

examples.chinese: 每次看到有河流經過的都市，就會想起我生長的家鄉。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì kàndào yǒu héliú jīngguò de dūshì, jiù huì xiǎngqǐ wǒ shēngzhǎng de jiāxiāng.
examples.english: Every time I see a city with a river passing through it, I think of the hometown where I grew up.

examples.chinese: 他放下工作回家鄉的理由，是因為家裡的農場無人照顧。
examples.pinyin: Tā fàngxià gōngzuò huí jiāxiāng de lǐyóu, shì yīnwèi jiā lǐ de nóngchǎng wú rén zhàogù.
examples.english: The reason he gave up his job and returned to his hometown is that no one was taking care of the family farm.

examples.chinese: 我的歷史作業寫完了，同時也把明天要報告的古蹟資料準備好了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de lìshǐ zuòyè xiě wán le, tóngshí yě bǎ míngtiān yào bàogào de gǔjì zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
examples.english: I finished my history homework, and at the same time I also prepared the information on historical sites for tomorrow's report.

examples.chinese: 每個人的想法、看法都不一樣，要是遇到意見不同時，就應該好好地溝通。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén de xiǎngfǎ, kànfǎ dōu bù yīyàng, yàoshi yùdào yìjiàn bùtóng shí, jiù yīnggāi hǎohǎo de gōutōng.
examples.english: Everyone's thoughts and views are different; if you encounter a difference of opinion, you should communicate well.

examples.chinese: 為了愛惜食物資源，同時也幫助生活困難的家庭，張老闆決定在國內開幾家食物銀行。
examples.pinyin: Wèile àixī shíwù zīyuán, tóngshí yě bāngzhù shēnghuó kùnnán de jiātíng, Zhāng lǎobǎn juédìng zài guónèi kāi jǐ jiā shíwù yínháng.
examples.english: In order to cherish food resources and at the same time help families with financial difficulties, Boss Zhang decided to open several food banks in the country.

examples.chinese: 我想加入社會服務組織，幫助別人的同時也讓自己成長。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng jiārù shèhuì fúwù zǔzhī, bāngzhù biérén de tóngshí yě ràng zìjǐ chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: I want to join a social service organization; while helping others, I can also let myself grow.

examples.chinese: 這次茶會主要是為了招待客戶，同時透過這個茶會來發表公司的新產品。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì cháhuì zhǔyào shì wèile zhāodài kèhù, tóngshí tòuguò zhège cháhuì lái fābiǎo gōngsī de xīn chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: This tea party is mainly to entertain clients, and at the same time, through this tea party, to launch the company's new products.

examples.chinese: 自動化工廠不僅使生產速度更快，同時也能保證產品品質。
examples.pinyin: Zìdònghuà gōngchǎng bùjǐn shǐ shēngchǎn sùdù gèng kuài, tóngshí yě néng bǎozhèng chǎnpǐn pǐnzhí.
examples.english: Automated factories not only make production speed faster but also can guarantee product quality.

examples.chinese: 想有效解決身材肥胖的問題，就應避免吃太肥的肉、太油的菜，同時還得多運動。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yǒuxiào jiějué shēncái féipàng de wèntí, jiù yīng bìmiǎn chī tài féi de ròu, tài yóu de cài, tóngshí hái děi duō yùndòng.
examples.english: If you want to effectively solve the problem of being obese, you should avoid eating meat that is too fatty and dishes that are too oily, and at the same time you also need to exercise more.

examples.chinese: 我們無法決定生命的長度，卻能夠決定生活的品質。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen wúfǎ juédìng shēngmìng de chángdù, què nénggòu juédìng shēnghuó de pǐnzhì.
examples.english: We cannot decide the length of life, but we can decide the quality of life.

examples.chinese: 你穿的這件衣服肩膀寬度很合適，就是長度太長了，要是能改短一些就好了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ chuān de zhè jiàn yīfu jiānbǎng kuāndù hěn héshì, jiùshì chángdù tài cháng le, yàoshì néng gǎi duǎn yīxiē jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: The shoulder width of this piece of clothing you're wearing is very suitable; it's just that the length is too long. If only it could be shortened a bit, that would be good.

examples.chinese: 以前學校規定女學生的髮型都要一樣，而且長度不能超過耳朵。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián xuéxiào guīdìng nǚ xuéshēng de fàxíng dōu yào yīyàng, érqiě chángdù bùnéng chāoguò ěrduo.
examples.english: In the past, the school required that female students' hairstyles all be the same, and the length could not exceed the ears.

examples.chinese: 妹妹個子比較高，手也長， 買衣服時都得注意袖子的長度。
examples.pinyin: Mèimei gèzi bǐjiào gāo, shǒu yě cháng, mǎi yīfu shí dōu děi zhùyì xiùzi de chángdù.
examples.english: My younger sister is relatively tall and has long arms, so when buying clothes she always has to pay attention to the sleeve length.

examples.chinese: 如果想捐頭髮，長度至少要十五公分以上才能捐。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng juān tóufa, chángdù zhìshǎo yào shíwǔ gōngfēn yǐshàng cái néng juān.
examples.english: If you want to donate hair, the length must be at least fifteen centimeters or more to be able to donate.

examples.chinese: 從那個偶像團體的舞蹈，就可以看出他們練(to practice)舞時花了多少工夫。
examples.pinyin: Cóng nàge ǒuxiàng tuántǐ de wǔdǎo, jiù kěyǐ kànchū tāmen liàn wǔ shí huā le duōshǎo gōngfu.
examples.english: From that idol group's dancing, you can tell how much effort they put into practicing dance.

examples.chinese: 這一盤棋你下得真好，你一定花了很多工夫研究。
examples.pinyin: Zhè yì pán qí nǐ xià de zhēn hǎo, nǐ yídìng huā le hěn duō gōngfu yánjiū.
examples.english: You played this game of chess really well; you must have spent a lot of effort studying.

examples.chinese: 新員工在經過專門的訓練後，都已能使用工廠各種生產機器。
examples.pinyin: Xīn yuángōng zài jīngguò zhuānmén de xùnliàn hòu, dōu yǐ néng shǐyòng gōngchǎng gè zhǒng shēngchǎn jīqì.
examples.english: After receiving specialized training, the new employees are all now able to use the various production machines in the factory.

examples.chinese: 這位記者專門報導社會新聞，他報新聞的方式相當專業。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jìzhě zhuānmén bàodǎo shèhuì xīnwén, tā bào xīnwén de fāngshì xiāngdāng zhuānyè.
examples.english: This reporter specializes in reporting social news; the way he reports news is quite professional.

examples.chinese: 我跟幾個愛好歷史的朋友一起組了社團，專門研究古文物。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn jǐ ge àihào lìshǐ de péngyǒu yìqǐ zǔ le shètuán, zhuānmén yánjiū gǔ wénwù.
examples.english: I formed a club together with several friends who love history, specifically to study ancient artifacts.

items.wordHook: a 亻(person) points straight at 尔(you) → that word is 你(you).
公(public) + 共(common) + 汽(steam) + 車(vehicle) → a public vehicle for everyone: 公共汽車(bus).
Combining 具(tool) and 有(have): 具有 means have.
Combining 基(foundation) and 本(this): 基本 means basic.
市(market) + 場(place) → the place where a market is held: 市場 means market.
Combining 規(rules) and 模(model): 規模 means scale.
A 告(tell) leans on a 非(fēi) fence to stay nearby → 靠(nearby).
